title: Deep Visual-Inertial Odometry
description: A stereo VIO system combining S-MSCKF filter-based fusion with a head-to-head comparison against three trained CNN-LSTM fusion networks — quantifying where classical filtering still beats learned approaches and where it doesn't.

stats.label: RMSE
stats.detail: Stereo VIO · EuRoC Benchmark · Classical Filter

extraText: Built a real-time S-MSCKF stereo VIO in C++ fusing IMU propagation with feature tracking, time alignment, and statistical outlier rejection. Achieves 0.091 m RMSE on the EuRoC benchmark for 6-DoF state estimation across multiple MAV sequences.

Trained and benchmarked three CNN-LSTM sensor-fusion networks against the classical filter in PyTorch on synthetic camera–IMU data — late fusion winning at 2.38 RMSE vs 5.24 / 2.82 for the other two architectures — with a reproducible, automated evaluation harness quantifying accuracy trade-offs.

The result is a clean comparison: filter-based methods remain the strongest baseline for accuracy on well-calibrated stereo+IMU, while learned approaches show promise specifically in fusion-strategy choice (late > early > intermediate in this setting).
